note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground on the east side of Fickle Lake, 31 km SW of Edson off Hwy 47, managed by West Fraser and the Fox Creek Development Association: spruce-forest sites, some with lake views, a boat launch, dock and fish-cleaning stand. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jan 28, 2026) and West Fraser's page: 36 unserviced sites C$25, season May 1 - Oct 31 (derived -> manual), 21 reservable by phone + 15 first-come, C$10 reservation fee (operator), vault toilets, hand pump (bring drinking water). Lakeview confirmed. Phone 780-865-2154 suggested; policy_ref none candidate.
flags: PHONE (stored empty): the Alberta Parks page's 'Information: 780-865-2154', which is also West Fraser's 'Reserve contact: Fox Creek Development Assoc. Ltd. 780-865-2154'. Recommend 780-865-2154. ('Facility Operator: West Fraser Mills-Fox Creek Development Association'.)

WEBSITE: the stored Alberta Parks camping page answered 200 and is this campground. Operator page (200, this campground): https://www.westfraser.com/responsibility/recreation/frma/campgrounds/fickle-lake-campground - could be added as a second line.

POLICY ROW: booking is by phone through the Fox Creek Development Association with a C$10 reservation fee ('$10/night reservation fee' on West Fraser's page), not shop.albertaparks.ca / C$12 / 90-day window as the provincial:AB row says. The campground is not on the shop. Wrote reservation_fee 10 on the entry; policy_ref none candidate (same as the West Fraser campgrounds in p3-392/393).
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'). West Fraser's Fickle page posts no senior rate.
ROAD: West Fraser: 'The road is accessible by 2-wheel drive.' (gravel resource road ~9 km). No problem stated.
SITES: AP page and West Fraser both say 36; the 2001 fact sheet's '44 campsites' is old. No per-site lengths published; no rig-length limit stated.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview; CONFIRMED): on Esri imagery the site spurs lie in dense spruce on the rise east of the lake; the westernmost spurs are ~20-30 m from the shoreline but with a continuous belt of spruce between them and the water, so lakefront is not met. The agency's own text says 'lovely campsites with lakeside views', which supports a view. Keep lakeview.

PIN (53.45318,-116.76346): on the access road just south of the site loops, ~150-170 m from their centre (~53.4546,-116.7641); the page's directions point 53.454208,-116.764637 is in the loops. Within 250 m - no move needed (optional move to the directions point).
